name: AFLplusplus/AFLplusplus
description: The state-of-the-art AFL fork with community patches, QEMU 5.1 upgrade, collision-free coverage, enhanced laf-intel & redqueen, MOpt mutators, unicorn_mode, and more. The de facto standard coverage-guided fuzzer for binary and source-instrumented targets.
score_rationale: Industry-standard coverage-guided fuzzer with 6.4k stars, actively maintained with releases into 2026, and the dominant choice for binary fuzzing research.
